facts.fact: Executive Decree 23-316 of 6 September 2023 obliges public bodies to connect their IT systems to the automated NIN generation system, per the Interior Minister.
The Interior Minister says public bodies are required under Executive Decree 23-316 to connect their IT systems to the automated NIN generation system.

systems.system: Registre National Automatise de l'Etat Civil (RNAEC)
